'''Vella Zarkot''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
A member of the [[Knights of Zakuul]], following the Coronation of Empress [[Vaylin]] she was hand-picked by her to join the new [[Horizon Guard]]. She was among the guards who accompanied the Empress and [[SCORPIO]] when they used subterfuge to initiate the [[assault on the Gravestone]]. After [[Lana Beniko]] and [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]] boarded the ''[[Gravestone]]'' determined to reclaim the vessel, Vaylin ordered to hunt down the intruders. Vella Zarkot located the Commander and [[Koth Vortena]] at the turbolife leading to the Dark Sanctuary and attacked them, but was defeated and killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vella Zarkot appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' Chapter III '''"Dark Reunions."'''
